Issue: LinkedIn link leads to a "Page not available" page.
Steps to Reproduce: Scroll to the footer and click the LinkedIn icon.
Expected Result: LinkedIn should open the official H-SETS company page.
Actual Result: A "Page not available" error is displayed.

Issue: Twitter/X link points to a non-existent profile.
Steps to Reproduce: Click the X icon in the footer.
Expected Result: The official H-SETS X profile should open.
Actual Result: The linked profile does not exist.

Issue: YouTube link opens an empty profile/channel.
Steps to Reproduce: Click the YouTube icon in the footer.
Expected Result: The official H-SETS YouTube channel should open with content.

Issue: Instagram link opens an unrelated account ("hsets") instead of the official H-SETS account.
Steps to Reproduce: Click the Instagram icon in the footer.
Expected Result: The official H-SETS Instagram page should open.
Actual Result: An unrelated Instagram account is opened.

Issue: Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions links both redirect to the Contact page.
Steps to Reproduce: Click the Privacy Policy and Terms links in the footer.
Expected Result: Each link should open its respective policy page.
Actual Result: Both links redirect to the Contact page.

Issue: "Try the Readiness Assessment" and "Start Assessment" buttons redirect to the Resources page instead of the assessment page.
Steps to Reproduce: Navigate to AI Solutions and click either CTA.
Actual Result: The Resources page is opened instead.

Issue: Clicking "AI Strategy" does not navigate to a new page or update the current content.
Steps to Reproduce: From the navigation menu, click AI Strategy.
Expected Result: The AI Strategy page or section should load.
Actual Result: The AI Solutions page remains unchanged.

Issue: Corporate Training and Graduate Stories links do not navigate anywhere.
Steps to Reproduce: Navigate to the Academy page and click the respective links.
Expected Result: Each item should navigate to its intended page or section.

Issue: "Templates & Checklists" and "Industry Reports" are not linked to any destination.
Steps to Reproduce: Navigate to Resources and click the respective items.
Expected Result: Each item should open or download the relevant resource.
Actual Result: Clicking the items has no effect.

Issue: Resource request acknowledgement email is received, but the promised download link is never sent.
Steps to Reproduce: Submit a request for a downloadable resource and wait for the follow-up email.
Expected Result: The requested download link should be delivered.
Actual Result: Only an acknowledgement email is received; no download link follows.

Issue: Broken image displayed in the acknowledgement email.
Steps to Reproduce: Open the acknowledgement email after requesting a resource.
Actual Result: A broken image placeholder is displayed.

Issue: Social media links in the acknowledgement email are incorrect just as those in the global footer.
Steps to Reproduce: Open the email and click each social media icon.
Expected Result: Each icon should open the official H-SETS social profile.

Issue: Sender details display victorolorunda6@gmail.com with Mr. Victor's profile image instead of official H-SETS branding.
Steps to Reproduce: Open the acknowledgement email and inspect the sender details.
Expected Result: The email should use an official H-SETS email address and branding.
Actual Result: A personal Gmail address and personal profile image are displayed.

Issue: Placeholder phone number (+234 800 000 0000) is still displayed.
Steps to Reproduce: Visit the Contact page or footer.
Expected Result: The official H-SETS phone number should be displayed.
Actual Result: A placeholder phone number is shown.

Issue: Booking confirmation states that a calendar invite has been sent, but no calendar invite (.ics or Add to Calendar link) is included in the confirmation email.
Steps to Reproduce: Book a consultation and open the confirmation email.
Expected Result: The email should include a calendar invitation or calendar attachment.
Actual Result: The email contains only a text confirmation.
